cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:4e1.title: Motorcycle Technician
locations: 5120 Peters Creek Rd NW, Roanoke, VA 24019
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:4e1.description: For over two decades, MotoSport has led the powersports industry with unmatched selection, quality, and expertise. Since our founding in 1999, we’ve been driven by one mission — to make your next ride your best ride. As a premier powersports retail e-commerce company, we’re dedicated to providing riders of all types with high-quality parts, gear, and accessories from the most trusted brands. When you reach out to us, you’re not just talking to a salesperson — you’re connecting with someone who rides, wrenches, and lives the lifestyle. The Motorcycle Technician is responsible for performing inspections, diagnosis, repairs, maintenance, and installations efficiently and according to the dealership’s quality, safety, and time standards. Primary objectives include ensuring customer satisfaction and retention by fixing units correctly on the first visit. This role may also be required to provide support to entry-level technicians on an as-needed basis Reports to: Service Manager Location: Roanoke, VA
responsibilities: The Technician will be responsible for achieving monthly and annual goals set by management
Perform pre-delivery inspections, routine tire changes, basic maintenance, and minor accessory installations
Maintain a fix it right the first time attitude while producing high-quality work with minimal comeback liability
Apply technical education while adopting best practices as outlined by the Service Manager and senior techs
Document work performed and recommended repairs on Repair Orders and checklists
Maintain an opening and closing regimen of cleaning and maintaining shared stations, including but not limited to battery stations, tire stations, and the shop floor
Monitor shop supplies and consumables such as fuel, oil, coolant, grease, wheel weights, etc. and proactively notify the Service Manager before supplies are depleted
Maintain a clean and organized dealership lot
Coordinate with Service Writer to stage jobs on deck for senior techs
Maintain minimum inventory of common tools to facilitate efficient and correct completion of assigned jobs
Tag and bag take off parts
Maintain a clean, safe, and organized service bay
Appropriately use all safety devices and personal protective equipment
Comply with all company safety programs, rules, regulations, procedures, and instructions that are applicable
Other tasks as assigned by the Service Manager
Assist other departments as needed at the direction of the Service Manager and General Manager
qualifications: 1-year experience as a technician/mechanic in an automotive or powersports service department
All necessary tools required to perform repairs and services
Ability to test ride vehicles in a safe and appropriate manner
Hold a current, nonrestricted, state-issued driver's license with a motorcycle endorsement preferred but not mandatory
Virginia State Inspector preferred but not required
Forklift experience preferred but not required
Common sense and willingness to learn
Ability to take and follow directions
Strong adherence to scheduling and punctuality

jobgether-jobgether:lever:596a7fae-3d53-.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:596a7fae-3d53-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Project Manager based in Spain. This is an opportunity to lead complex, high-visibility projects from initial planning through successful delivery and handover. You will work across multiple workstreams, balancing strategic priorities with budgets, resources, timelines, and operational requirements. The role requires strong executive presence and the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and C-level leaders. You will apply both Agile and Waterfall methodologies to adapt delivery approaches to each project’s needs. Success will depend on your ability to anticipate risks, communicate clearly, and drive accountability across teams and partners. This is a fully remote environment suited to an experienced project leader who thrives on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, and success criteria in partnership with executive and cross-functional stakeholders. Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, charters, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation strategies. Lead projects throughout the full lifecycle, from initiation and planning through execution, closure, and operational handover. Manage project budgets, forecasts, financial performance, resource utilization, and variance analysis while identifying opportunities for cost optimization. Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain alignment and deliver project objectives. Build strong relationships with senior leadership and C-level executives, providing clear updates, recommendations, and escalation management. Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall methodologies according to project requirements, facilitating ceremonies and stage-gate processes as appropriate. Track project KPIs, milestones, schedule variance, budget health, resource utilization, risks, and overall delivery performance. Identify potential risks, dependencies, conflicts, and delivery issues, developing mitigation strategies and driving timely resolution. Prepare executive-level presentations, dashboards, reports, and project documentation covering progress, risks, decisions, and key performance indicators. Lead process improvement initiatives, capture lessons learned, and establish best practices to improve future project delivery. Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and coordinate formal handover, documentation, archiving, and closure of outstanding contractual or financial activities. Requirements 5+ years of proven project management experience, with responsibility for leading projects from conception through completion. Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, forecasting, financial analysis, resource allocation, and cost control. Advanced knowledge of Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. Experience working directly with senior stakeholders, executives, and C-level leadership. Proficiency with project management and tracking tools such as Jira, Trello, MS Project, or equivalent platforms. Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly PowerPoint for executive presentations and Excel for financial and project analysis. Strong ability to define, monitor, analyze, and communicate project KPIs and performance metrics. Excellent written and spoken English, with strong presentation, negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred; a Master's degree is a plus. PMP, PMI-ACP, or another relevant project management certification is strongly preferred. Strategic mindset with the ability to connect project objectives to broader organizational goals. Strong problem-solving, risk management, organizational, and decision-making skills. Ability to balance strategic pr

jobgether-jobgether:lever:bb97ec78-f37d-.title: Content and Social Media Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bb97ec78-f37d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Content and Social Media Manager based in United Kingdom. As a Content and Social Media Manager, you’ll own the editorial engine across multiple channels, creating content that strengthens brand visibility and generates qualified business opportunities. You’ll combine strong writing skills with strategic thinking to produce authoritative content for blogs, websites, sales materials, press communications, and email campaigns. A major part of the role will involve building a compelling LinkedIn presence through distinctive narratives, relevant insights, and experimentation with new formats. You’ll work closely with subject matter experts, marketers, product teams, and senior leaders to turn complex ideas into clear, credible, engaging stories. The role offers significant creative ownership, from planning the editorial calendar through writing, publishing, performance analysis, and optimization. You’ll join a fast-moving international environment where initiative, curiosity, and a willingness to experiment are highly valued. This is an ideal opportunity for a hands-on content professional who wants to shape a growing B2B technology brand through exceptional writing and social storytelling. Own and manage the editorial calendar across blogs, LinkedIn, email campaigns, website content, and sales materials, ensuring content is planned, produced, and published on schedule. Write and edit long-form content, including blog articles, bylined pieces, data-driven reports, one-pagers, and website copy. Transform input from internal experts into authoritative, accessible content that delivers meaningful value to a professional B2B audience. Lead day-to-day social media execution across LinkedIn and emerging channels, developing compelling content and testing new formats and narratives. Develop and manage press releases related to product launches, partnerships, licensing milestones, company announcements, and other significant developments. Coordinate press distribution with relevant trade publications, media outlets, and external PR partners. Adapt existing and newly produced video content for social media in collaboration with marketing and creative stakeholders. Monitor content and social media performance, identify successful formats and topics, and adjust the editorial strategy based on results. Collaborate with marketing leadership, subject matter experts, traders, product managers, and executives to develop credible and engaging stories. Continuously explore new content approaches, formats, tools, and workflows to strengthen the effectiveness of the editorial operation. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience in content marketing, editorial, communications , or a closely related field, ideally within B2B technology. A portfolio demonstrating strong long-form and short-form content that you have personally written, developed, and published. Proven experience using LinkedIn as a B2B content and marketing channel , with a strong understanding of what drives engagement and business impact. Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and adapt tone and format to different audiences and channels. Demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical input from subject matter experts into clear, credible, and engaging content. Strong editorial judgment and a willingness to experiment with emerging content formats and storytelling approaches. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership in a fast-moving environment without requiring a detailed playbook. Strong analytical mindset and ability to use content and social performance data to inform future decisions. Experience in iGaming, esports, betting, gaming, or another regulated industry is an advantage. Familiarity with HubSpot is a plus. Experience working within a startup or scal

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8c36626-b216-.title: Database Administrator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8c36626-b216-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Database Administrator based in Brazil. This is a fully remote opportunity supporting mission-critical Oracle database environments for a U.S.-based client in the pharmaceutical industry. The role focuses on production database administration, performance, reliability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You’ll work hands-on with Oracle 12c–19c while contributing to upgrades, migrations, ETL processes, and database optimization. The position also provides exposure to PostgreSQL and MongoDB within a distributed international technical environment. You’ll collaborate with developers, infrastructure teams, and other stakeholders to resolve complex database challenges and maintain reliable systems. This role is well suited to an experienced DBA who combines strong technical expertise with analytical thinking and independent execution. It offers the opportunity to work on long-term projects while supporting highly important systems from anywhere in Latin America. Provide day-to-day production support and administration for Oracle databases, ensuring reliability and availability. Monitor database health, performance, capacity, and overall operational status. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve database incidents and production issues efficiently. Perform database performance tuning, including SQL query optimization, index management, and server/database configuration. Develop, maintain, modify, and manage SQL queries, database objects, and structures. Participate in Oracle database upgrades, migrations, and related technical initiatives, including 12c-to-19c upgrades. Support data migration and ETL processes, ensuring data is transferred and processed reliably. Work with PostgreSQL and MongoDB environments when required. Collaborate with developers, infrastructure teams, and other technical stakeholders to diagnose issues and implement effective solutions. Follow established best practices for database security, reliability, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and change management. Contribute to the continuous improvement, automation, monitoring, and operational efficiency of database environments. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as an Oracle Database Administrator , with significant production-support experience. Advanced English proficiency at approximately B2/C1 level , with the ability to communicate effectively in both written and spoken English. Native Spanish or Portuguese proficiency. Strong SQL expertise, including querying, creating, modifying, and managing database structures. Hands-on experience with Oracle Database 12c–19c . Experience with Oracle database upgrades, particularly migrations from 12c to 19c, is highly preferred. Strong knowledge of database performance tuning, including SQL queries, indexes, and server/database configuration. Experience with data migration and ETL processes . Knowledge or hands-on experience with PostgreSQL/Postgres SQL . Knowledge or hands-on experience with MongoDB . Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work independently and effectively within a distributed, international environment. Experience in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals, healthcare, biotechnology, or financial services is a plus. Experience supporting high-availability or mission-critical production environments is a plus. Familiarity with backup/recovery, disaster recovery, high-availability solutions, cloud-based databases, monitoring, or automation tools is advantageous. Benefits: 100% remote work from Latin America. Competitive salary paid in USD . Long-term opportunity. Independent Contractor agreement. 10 paid business days / 2 weeks of PTO . Paid U.S. holidays . Full-time working schedule aligned with EST hours . Opportunity to work with international technical teams and mission-critical database environ

jobgether-jobgether:lever:edde01aa-73dd-.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:edde01aa-73dd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in Ireland. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. Experience working with cloud platforms and associated logging, monitoring, and analytics services,

rws-rws:lever:bc1410f2-58c7-4ba3-b3ec-0f.title: Social Media Content Evaluator (German)
rws-rws:lever:bc1410f2-58c7-4ba3-b3ec-0f.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: Germany (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 18 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in Germany. Native-level written and spoken fluency in German. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

titanwh-titanwh:lever:76389824-5718-4500.title: Paraplanner
titanwh-titanwh:lever:76389824-5718-4500.description: The Titan Group provides a broad range of services across the whole wealth value chain – from financial planning, investment management through to platform, trading, settlement and custody services. Its strategy is to be able to offer modular, incremental services to its clients allowing them to adjust their business models as and when they choose to. As part of this Titan is also an active acquirer of UK based asset managers and other wealth related businesses. Due to this Titan Wealth is expanding rapidly through strategic acquisitions, offering a unique combination of start-up energy and the security of private equity backing. It’s an inspiring time to join the team! Titan Wealth Planning (TWP) is a subsidiary of Titan Wealth. Our focus is providing best-in-class advice on wealth management, employee benefits, and retirement planning. Our mission is to help businesses and their employees explore, set, and achieve their financial goals. We are interested in speaking with individuals based in Newcastle for this position! The main purpose of this role is research and write advice reports, support training and development of the team, and to take an active role in maintaining paraplanning tools and reference material. We offer a competitive hybrid working pattern for this Senior Paraplanning role. As part of your Senior role within Paraplanning you will be responsible for providing support to the team manager as required. Deputising during periods of absence, providing coaching, mentoring or training support for the team and being a model of excellence. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to step up to the next level as a Paraplanner.
responsibilities: To draft suitability reports with guidance from the Financial Planner, in accordance with all compliance and departmental requirements.
To liaise with the Financial Planners to ensure all information received is complete and accurate for advice to be given.
Assist in the interpretation of the adviser’s client meeting and prepare suitable recommendations with a high level of accuracy and care.
Provide guidance to advisers on aspects of specific cases to support good consumer outcomes.
To ensure that the customer experience follows the Group’s defined standards and TCF is always maintained.
To ensure that all relevant research, client support and Compliance and Systems processes are always observed to maintain excellent data quality and compliant performance in the job role.
Update workflow records to facilitate the production of accurate management information in a timely manner.
Manage workloads as required and liaise with Line Manager to highlight over/under capacity. Ensuring relevant workflows are kept up to date to accurately reflect workflow.
Follow and promote best practice for all adviser support and client facing processes, ensuring consistent process and output quality.
Ensure effective communication with CS, advisers, and other colleagues to ensure a great customer experience.
To run own case load efficiently and keep all own case records and files up to date and to departmental required standards.
To obtain data for existing policies/schemes of clients and analyse/research the information provided, using various software programs as appropriate.
To obtain illustrations and Key Features documentation in support of recommendations to clients.
Ensure technical knowledge and general industry knowledge is always maintained.
Providing coaching, mentoring, or training support for Paraplanners
Being a model of excellence and Group process adherence
Proactively identify opportunities to improve paraplanning process
qualifications: Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Methodical and highly organised.

Complex problem solving.

High degree of numeracy.
Enthusiasm.
